Animaker bundles a custom audio-only FFmpeg 8.1.2 executable for Windows x86_64.

Upstream project:
https://ffmpeg.org/

Exact source archive:
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz

Source archive SHA-256:
464beb5e7bf0c311e68b45ae2f04e9cc2af88851abb4082231742a74d97b524c

Bundled executable SHA-256:
db0e742349eae6c7c21a7c33d0b7469dd2a7ba6219a3963af32f4d6eb19c4ea2

The executable was built from unmodified FFmpeg source with GCC 16.1.0 and
NASM 2.16.03 from MSYS2. See BUILD.txt for the complete configuration.

This build contains only the native FFmpeg components needed to decode local
WAV, Ogg Vorbis/Opus, MP3, FLAC, M4A/AAC and raw AAC audio to PCM WAV. Network,
device and video processing support is disabled.

FFmpeg is invoked as a separate executable. This build is licensed under the
GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
